description.value: An extension of Howe Sound Brewing's award-winning Squamish brewpub (founded 1996), this East Hastings taphouse brings craft beer and a full kitchen to a vibrant, community-oriented neighbourhood. The space leans into East Van's diverse character with regular drag brunches, paint-and-sip nights, and live sports alongside stone-fired pizzas, burgers, and hearty shareables. Private event rooms accommodate up to 150 guests, making it a destination as much as a pit stop.
